title: Multiple Classes – Migration – Deprecated Class Field – Not Visible on SF Lesson Schedule Layout
description: AC 04.1 (BR-21/37) — Regression Analysis — Validates that after migration the deprecated LS-level Class field is not shown on any SF Lesson Schedule layout.
preconditions: - SF org post-migration\n- At least one Lesson Schedule exists\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to any Lesson Schedule record in SF
2. Scan the Lesson Schedule Detail for a standalone "Class" field
3. Click Edit on the Lesson Schedule
4. Scan the edit form for a "Class" field
5. Cancel the edit
steps_result:
1. Lesson Schedule Detail displayed
2. No standalone Class field on the Detail layout
3. Edit form opens
4. No Class input field on the edit form
5. Edit closed

title: Multiple Classes – Migration – Deprecated Class Field – Not Visible on BO Lesson Detail Layout
description: AC 04.1 (BR-37) — Regression Analysis — Validates that the deprecated LS-level Class field is not shown on BO Lesson Detail or Lesson List after migration.
preconditions: - SF + BO post-migration; Unleash BO flag ON\n- Logged in as HQ Staff or CM Staff to BO
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to BO Lesson List
2. Scan column headers for deprecated "Class (LS)" column
3. Click any lesson to open BO Lesson Detail
4. Scan Lesson Detail fields for the deprecated LS-level Class field
steps_result:
1. BO Lesson List displayed
2. No deprecated LS-level class column; only formula-derived class visible
3. BO Lesson Detail opens
4. No deprecated LS-level Class field; only formula-derived Class shown

title: Multiple Classes – Formula Field – Single-Class Lesson – Single Class Name Displayed Without Extra Formatting (Backward Compatibility)
description: AC 04.2 (BR-22) — Regression Analysis — Validates that the Class formula on a migrated single-class lesson shows exactly the class name with no extra formatting.
preconditions: - SF org post-migration\n- Lesson "Lesson MC-Legacy" has 1 LSC record for Class Alpha\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to SF Lesson Detail for "Lesson MC-Legacy"
2. Read the Class formula field value
3. Navigate to BO Lesson Detail for "Lesson MC-Legacy"
4. Read the Class field in BO
steps_result:
1. SF Lesson Detail displayed
2. Class field shows "Class Alpha" only (no trailing comma or separator)
3. BO Lesson Detail displayed
4. BO shows "Class Alpha" — matches SF

title: Multiple Classes – Formula Field – Two Classes Assigned – Comma-Separated Names Displayed on SF and BO
description: AC 04.2 (BR-22/23) — Regression Analysis — Validates that the Class formula on a multi-class lesson displays comma-separated names on both SF and BO.
preconditions: - SF flag TRUE; BO flag ON\n- Lesson "Lesson MC-Multi" has 2 LSC records: Class Alpha and Class Beta\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to SF and BO
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to SF Lesson Detail for "Lesson MC-Multi"
2. Read the Class formula field
3. Navigate to BO Lesson Detail for "Lesson MC-Multi"
4. Read the Class field in BO
5. Navigate to the Lesson Schedule Detail and read Class in the Lesson related list
6. Confirm values are consistent
steps_result:
1. SF Lesson Detail displayed
2. Class shows "Class Alpha, Class Beta"
3. BO Lesson Detail displayed
4. BO shows "Class Alpha, Class Beta"
5. Related list Class column shows "Class Alpha, Class Beta"
6. All surfaces display identical value

title: Multiple Classes – Class Schedule Related List – SF Class Record – Tab Label and Columns Are Correct
description: AC 04.3 (BR-24/25/26) — CRUD Testing — Validates the SF Class record related list has tab label "Class Schedule" and shows correct columns sourced from LSC.
preconditions: - SF post-migration\n- Class Alpha has at least 2 LSC records linking to different Lesson Schedules\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to Class Alpha record in SF
2. Find the related list tab for lesson schedules
3. Read the tab label
4. Inspect column headers in the related list
5. Verify entries match LSC records for Class Alpha
6. Click the Lesson Schedule hyperlink in one row
steps_result:
1. Class record Detail displayed
2. Related list tab visible
3. Tab label reads "Class Schedule"
4. Columns: Lesson Name, Start Date, End Date, Lesson Schedule hyperlink
5. Rows correspond to lessons linked via LSC
6. Navigates to correct Lesson Schedule record

title: Multiple Classes – Class Schedule Related List – BO Class Record – Related List Updated from LSC Source
description: AC 04.3 (BR-40) — CRUD Testing — Validates that the BO Class detail Class Schedule related list is also updated to source from LSC.
preconditions: - BO flag ON\n- Class Alpha has at least 1 LSC-based lesson\n- Logged in as HQ Staff or CM Staff to BO
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to Class Alpha detail page in BO
2. Locate the Class Schedule related list
3. Read the tab label
4. Read the lesson entries
5. Add a new LSC for Class Alpha via SF and wait for sync; confirm new lesson appears in BO list
steps_result:
1. BO Class detail displayed
2. Class Schedule section visible
3. Tab label reads "Class Schedule"
4. List shows lessons with LSC records for Class Alpha
5. After sync, new lesson appears in the BO list

title: Multiple Classes – LSC Cascade Delete – Lesson Schedule Deleted – LSC Records Removed and Class Formula Shows Empty
description: BR-36 — CRUD Testing — Validates that deleting a Lesson Schedule cascade-deletes its LSC records and the Class formula on associated lessons becomes empty.
preconditions: - SF flag TRUE\n- Lesson Schedule "LS-Delete-01" has 2 LSC records (Class Alpha and Class Beta) and 1 Lesson\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to "LS-Delete-01" and open Lesson Schedule Detail
2. Note both LSC record IDs from the related list
3. Click Delete on "LS-Delete-01" and confirm
4. Search SF for both noted LSC record IDs
5. Navigate to the Lesson and read its Class formula field
steps_result:
1. LSC related list shows 2 records
2. Both IDs noted
3. "LS-Delete-01" deleted
4. Neither LSC record exists (cascade-deleted with the parent LS)
5. Class formula field is empty
